name: Inês Carvalho
bio:
Inês Carvalho's journey into motorsport began in her father's small auto repair shop in the outskirts of Lisbon. Growing up surrounded by engines and tools, she developed a keen understanding of mechanics at a young age. While other kids played with dolls, Inês was disassembling and reassembling carburetors. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on advanced materials and manufacturing processes. After graduating, she quickly gained experience in several smaller racing teams before landing a coveted spot with Team WRT.

As a fabricator, Inês is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her innovative approach to problem-solving. She thrives under pressure and always seeks to optimize performance, pushing the boundaries of what's possible within the team's resources. Inês firmly believes that the smallest adjustments can make a monumental difference on the track, and her passion for precision is infectious.

What sets Inês apart is her ability to blend technical expertise with a practical, hands-on approach. She isn't afraid to get her hands dirty and is always eager to experiment with new techniques and materials. Her dedication to her craft and her relentless pursuit of excellence make her a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail during work.
physical.description: Inês is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Insists on using only metric tools, even when working with older, imperial-sized components.
Has a lucky wrench that she always keeps in her toolbox, even though she rarely uses it.
